title: Full-Stack Engineer Advancement roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen core expertise, build showcase projects, and prepare for senior roles. Focuses on modern JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node/Django, SQL, deployment, and system design fundamentals.

phases.title: Foundations refresh
phases.summary: Re-establish core language and framework fundamentals.

milestones.title: JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Write clean, type-safe code across the stack.

tasks.title: Read TypeScript handbook sections 1-4
tasks.description: Study basic types, interfaces, and enums on the official TypeScript docs.

tasks.title: Complete freeCodeCamp ES6 & TypeScript challenges
tasks.description: Finish the interactive exercises to solidify syntax and typing concepts.

tasks.title: Refactor a small Node script to TypeScript
tasks.description: Take an existing JavaScript utility, add a tsconfig, and fix type errors.

tasks.title: Write unit tests with Jest for the refactored script
tasks.description: Create at least three test cases to verify functionality and type safety.

tasks.title: Reflect on type-related bugs you encountered
tasks.description: Write a short note on how static typing prevented or could have prevented errors.

milestones.title: SQL core concepts
milestones.outcome: Design, query, and optimise relational databases confidently.

tasks.title: Read PostgreSQL tutorial on SELECT basics (official docs)
tasks.description: Cover SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, and LIMIT clauses.

tasks.title: Complete SQLBolt exercises 1-6
tasks.description: Practice filtering, joining, and aggregating data in an interactive environment.

tasks.title: Model a simple e-commerce schema on paper
tasks.description: Sketch tables for users, products, orders, and relationships.

tasks.title: Implement the schema in a local PostgreSQL instance
tasks.description: Create tables, constraints, and sample data using psql commands.

tasks.title: Explain one indexing strategy you used
tasks.description: Write a brief explanation of why you chose a particular index.

phases.title: Core skills overview
phases.summary: Advance full-stack capabilities with modern frameworks and deployment pipelines.

milestones.title: React & Next.js proficiency
milestones.outcome: Build performant, SEO-friendly front-ends with server-side rendering.

tasks.title: Read Next.js 13 docs on routing and data fetching
tasks.description: Focus on the App Router, server components, and fetch API.

tasks.title: Complete a freeCodeCamp Next.js project tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the step-by-step guide to create a multi-page site.

tasks.title: Add TypeScript to the tutorial project
tasks.description: Convert pages and components to .tsx, fixing any type errors.

tasks.title: Implement client-side caching with SWR
tasks.description: Integrate SWR hooks to cache API responses and improve UX.

tasks.title: Connect with a Next.js community on Discord
tasks.description: Introduce yourself and ask a question about server components.

milestones.title: Node.js & Django backend expertise
milestones.outcome: Design APIs and services with Node or Django.

tasks.title: Read official Node.js docs on streams and async patterns
tasks.description: Cover readable/writable streams and async/await best practices.

tasks.title: Follow Django tutorial on building a blog (official docs)
tasks.description: Create models, views, and templates for a simple blog app.

tasks.title: Build a RESTful API with Express and TypeScript
tasks.description: Create CRUD endpoints for a resource, include validation middleware.

tasks.title: Add JWT authentication to the Express API
tasks.description: Implement login, token issuance, and protected routes.

tasks.title: Reflect on trade-offs between Node and Django
tasks.description: Write a brief comparison of scalability, ecosystem, and developer experience.

phases.title: Proof of work (portfolio projects)
phases.summary: Create real-world applications that showcase end-to-end skills.

milestones.title: SaaS billing App
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate full-stack feature delivery from DB to UI.

tasks.title: Define product requirements and user stories
tasks.description: Write at least five core features and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Design relational schema for subscriptions and payments
tasks.description: Create ER diagram and SQL scripts for tables and relationships.

tasks.title: Implement backend API with Next.js API routes or Express
tasks.description: Provide endpoints for plans, invoices, and webhook handling.

tasks.title: Create React UI for plan selection and checkout
tasks.description: Use React components, form validation, and Stripe integration.

tasks.title: Deploy the app to Vercel and Railway
tasks.description: Set up CI/CD, environment variables, and monitor logs.

milestones.title: Real-time chat application
milestones.outcome: Show ability to handle websockets and live updates.

tasks.title: Sketch feature list and data flow diagram
tasks.description: Outline user authentication, rooms, and message storage.

tasks.title: Set up a PostgreSQL schema for messages and rooms
tasks.description: Create tables with appropriate indexes for fast retrieval.

tasks.title: Implement WebSocket server with Node and Socket.io
tasks.description: Handle connection, room join, and broadcast messages.

tasks.title: Build React front-end with real-time message list
tasks.description: Use hooks to connect to Socket.io client and update UI instantly.

tasks.title: Write a short post on dev.to about challenges faced
tasks.description: Summarize technical hurdles and solutions for peer feedback.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish portfolio, learn system design basics, and prepare for senior interviews.

milestones.title: System design basics
milestones.outcome: Explain and diagram common web architectures.

tasks.title: Read system design primer chapter on scalability
tasks.description: Focus on load balancing, caching, and database sharding concepts.

tasks.title: Sketch a high-level design for a video-streaming service
tasks.description: Include CDN, microservices, and data storage layers.

tasks.title: Discuss the design with a peer on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Share the diagram and ask for feedback on trade-offs.

tasks.title: Practice answering a system design interview question
tasks.description: Time yourself delivering a 10-minute solution for an e-commerce checkout flow.

tasks.title: Reflect on gaps in your knowledge
tasks.description: Write three topics you need to study further and plan next steps.

milestones.title: Portfolio polish & personal brand
milestones.outcome: Present a professional, interview-ready portfolio and résumé.

tasks.title: Write case studies for each portfolio project
tasks.description: Describe problem, approach, tech stack, and impact in 300-400 words each.

tasks.title: Create a responsive portfolio site with Next.js
tasks.description: Showcase projects, include GitHub links, and add a contact form.

tasks.title: Deploy the portfolio site to Vercel with a custom domain
tasks.description: Configure DNS, environment variables, and analytics.

tasks.title: Add CI/CD badge and test coverage badge to GitHub repos
tasks.description: Use GitHub Actions to run tests and display status on README.

tasks.title: Network with senior engineers on Twitter and share your work
tasks.description: Post a thread linking to your case studies and ask for feedback.

milestones.title: Senior-level interview prep
milestones.outcome: Confidently tackle coding, design, and leadership interview rounds.

tasks.title: Solve 5 hard LeetCode problems in JavaScript
tasks.description: Choose problems tagged Hard, focus on optimal time/space solutions.

tasks.title: Review behavioral STAR stories for leadership examples
tasks.description: Write concise narratives for conflict resolution, mentorship, and impact.

tasks.title: Mock system design interview with a peer
tasks.description: Run a 45-minute session, receive feedback, and iterate on the design.

tasks.title: Read Cracking the coding interview chapter on JavaScript nuances
tasks.description: Refresh language-specific pitfalls and best practices for interviews.

tasks.title: Update résumé with quantified achievements
tasks.description: Add metrics such as performance improvements or feature delivery speed.
